I deleted "He shall break the nations and shatter the world." This is not a quote from the prophecies. Moiraine says in {{TDR|6}} "He has yet to break the nations, or shatter the world." She was referring to two different lines in the prophecies, not quoting a line. The line she was referring to is "For he shall come like the breaking dawn,
and shatter the world again with his coming, and make it anew." The line about breaking the nations could refer to "Women shall weep and men quail as the nations of the earth are rent like rotting cloth." The problem with that is in that line, the prophecies are talking about the dark one, not the Dragon. It could be moiraine had a momentary lapse.[[User:Joedmd|Joe]] 04:23, February 11, 2011 (UTC)
